pa.reason_text: Step therapy not met: no trial of a topical calcineurin inhibitor documented.

documents.content: Dx: atopic dermatitis L20.9, IGA 3, BSA 15%, allergist. TCS: fluocinonide 0.05% ointment 04/01/2026-05/15/2026, inadequate. TCI: not trialed, contraindicated (see letter). No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

Patient has recurrent eczema herpeticum: three episodes, most recent 06/2026, which required IV acyclovir. Given this history, topical calcineurin inhibitors are contraindicated for this patient. Signed, Dr. Hannah Okafor, Allergy & Immunology.

_source.linked_by: AI: D. Okoro TCI contraindication letter from Dr. Okafor matches the case.

documents.content:
Hi Forus team,

Following up on the Dupixent request for our patient Daniel Okoro (DOB 06/27/1991).
Dr. Okafor signed the medical necessity letter yesterday; it went over by fax.

Short version: three episodes of eczema herpeticum, the last one in June 2026 needed IV
acyclovir. Dr. Okafor considers topical calcineurin inhibitors contraindicated for him.
He used fluocinonide 0.05% ointment from April 1 to May 15 this year without enough improvement.

Thanks,
Dana R., front desk, Metro Allergy Partners
